item.title: Version 2.1.0
item.description:
## New
- **Meeting detection is back.** When a call starts, OpenOats asks "Record this meeting?" Click the notification (or Record) and it records; when the call ends, the recording stops by itself and is processed as usual. - **It asks about real calls only.** A call is an app like Zoom, Teams, FaceTime, Slack, WhatsApp or a browser using your microphone along with your speakers or camera. Dictation apps, voice notes and a camera on its own don't count, and the prompt names the app that's actually on the call. - **Browser calls are detected.** A Meet, Teams or Zoom call in Chrome, Arc, Safari, Brave, Edge, Firefox and other browsers now gets the prompt too. - **One prompt per call.** It disappears when the call ends or you start recording. "Don't Ask for <app>" stops prompts for that app; Settings → General turns detection off or asks again for apps you ignored. - While a call is on, the menu bar shows it and the button reads "Record <app> Call".
Detection only reads which apps use the mic, speakers and camera, never the audio or video, and needs no new permission. Recordings you start yourself still never stop on their own.
